title: Canonical structure-module map on algebraic spaces
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and let $f:X\to Y$ be a morphism of algebraic spaces over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], in the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. Use the module categories [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] and the canonical direct image with its chart-limit projections [def-trf-space-etale-module-functors]. Define $f^\sharp:\mathcal O_Y\to f_*\mathcal O_X$ to be the unique module-sheaf morphism such that for every etale scheme chart $V\to Y$, every chart $(T,a)$ of $X\times_Y V$, and every $s\in\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_V)$, the $(T,a)$ projection of $f^\sharp_V(s)$ is $a^\sharp(s)\in\Gamma(T,\mathcal O_T)$. Existence is supplied by the limit of the compatible regular-function pullbacks; the projections determine the map uniquely.
